mapper.select: SELECT user_id, name, usage_log_agreed, guardian_share_agreed, consent_completed, font_size, voice_speed, guide_voice_type FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET usage_log_agreed = #{usageLogAgreed}, guardian_share_agreed = #{guardianShareAgreed}, consent_completed = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId}
